detours.why: D-621: the NFC_RFO2 SE dogleg -- the 3-track minimal cut of NFC_RFI1 and part of NFC_RFI2's -- relaid between its own two FREE ends (37.025,29.875 and L6.1) so the U9 receive channel opens.  Neither end is the EXACT-margin U9.15 land, so the lattice can relay this where D-620 proved it cannot relay the whole arm.  max_mm 3.5 is an RF bound, not a search bound: .kicad_dru section 7 records transmit-arm symmetry as an unresolved placement precondition (PM-3) with arm B already the longer one, so this relay is only acceptable while it costs arm B a fraction of a millimetre.

note: D-621: C17 -- the +3V3 decoupler between L5 and L6 -- must have LEFT the pocket before this relay has anywhere to go.  With C17 in place the shortest relay measured is 9.470 mm (+6.583 mm on arm B) and NFC_RFI2 still refuses; with C17 gone it is 3.158 mm at grid 50000 and BOTH receive nets close.
